findings.issue: The entire layout (banner, nav, main, footer) is gated on <Show when={names()}> from the team-names query, so the team feature is woven into the app shell; a failing team fetch renders no page at all, and removing the team feature means unwinding the shell.
findings.suggestion: Render the shell unconditionally and keep TeamProvider optional (e.g. default the initial names to [] with a non-blocking createAsync, or resolve the cookie before the shell without gating it).

findings.issue: The shared PokéAPI data module reads the team cookie (getCookie) and imports the client-side team-store, mixing browser-persistence policy into the API client layer.
findings.suggestion: Move teamNames()/cookie handling into a dedicated server module (or accept names as a parameter like teamDetail already does) so pokeapi.ts stays purely a PokeAPI client.

findings.issue: The sprite URL template is duplicated between card() and homeList, so a sprite-scheme change (the Deoxys-style fix) must be applied in two places.
findings.suggestion: Extract a spriteUrl(id) helper (or have homeList items go through card()) so the pattern lives in one place.

findings.issue: The generic card list component carries a team-specific onRemove prop and renders the 'Remove <name>' button, baking team UI policy into a shared component.
findings.suggestion: Accept a generic per-item action render prop, or compose the remove button in the team route (e.g. wrap the card list) so PokemonCards stays domain-neutral.

findings.issue: The Switch/Match null-check + NotFound + preload scaffolding is repeated verbatim in four detail routes (also pokemon/[name].tsx:166, abilities/[name].tsx:17, types/[name].tsx:15); an Items section would copy it a fifth time.
findings.suggestion: A tiny shared helper (e.g. a <ResourcePage data={...}> wrapper that renders NotFound on null) would centralize the not-found handling while keeping each route's body unchanged.

findings.issue: Card encodes per-list variants as optional fields (types?, hidden?), so every consumer must know which optional flags the current list populates.
findings.suggestion: Acceptable as-is given the spec's three card variants; if more variants appear, consider a variant map or a discriminated per-list props model.

findings.issue: Search-param array normalization ('first') is reimplemented inline at app/src/routes/pokemon/[name].tsx:62 for the game param.
findings.suggestion: Export the first() helper from a shared module (e.g. ~/lib/format or a small router-helpers file) and use it in both routes.

findings.issue: CountText, an unrelated count-text helper, is exported from the card-list component file, weakening file cohesion.
findings.suggestion: Move CountText to its own small component (or a text components module).

findings.issue: The header row is generic over COLUMNS but the body enumerates cells by hand, so adding a column requires edits in the column model, valueOf and the tbody.
findings.suggestion: Render body cells from the same COLUMNS model (row[key]) so a new column is a one-line addition.

summary: This is a well-seamed SolidStart 2 app: all network access, caching and data shaping live in one server module behind typed DTOs and query wrappers, and all repeated UI flows through a handful of genuinely reusable components, so most changes land in one obvious place. The main editability debt is the team feature's reach into shared code — the app shell gates all rendering on the team query, the server data module reads the team cookie, and the generic card list carries a team-specific action. Remaining nits are duplicated sprite/param helpers and four copies of the detail-route scaffolding idiom.
